add_bbox_site: add a box-shaped site to an MJCF body for visualizing a bounding box with lower and upper bounds
add_target_site: add a sphere-shaped site to an MJCF body for visualizing a target location with a given radius
create_BoundingBox: create a BoundingBox namedtuple with lower and upper coordinate sequences for workspace bounds
use_uniform_z_rotation: use the uniform_z_rotation distribution to sample random Z-axis quaternion rotations between negative and positive pi
use_DOWN_QUATERNION: use the DOWN_QUATERNION constant to set a downward-facing orientation for a manipulator hand
